reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 19. Nay or No: 21. Not Voting: 0. said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

posts.text: Today, I led a letter demanding an immediate investigation of the nearly $7.5 billion private contract to build the Big Bend border wall, and - come January 3rd - the Trump Administration will answer for every single cent spent trying to destroy our public lands.
Last June, Democrats tried to pass an amendment to prevent the use of federal funds for border barriers at Big Bend, yet every single Republican - including those from Texas - voted against it.

Donald Trump, Stephen Miller, and their Supreme Court majority remain hellbent on funneling taxpayer dollars to out-of-state contractors to get rich by building a border wall through our state's crown jewel. https://t.co/KPievn5o9n

Your federal government should work just as hard for you as you do for your family. That is what drove my vote five years ago, and it’s why - as your Member of Congress - I will never stop fighting for lower costs, good-paying jobs, and a healthier future for you and your family.

I have long said that budgets are a reflection of our priorities. Democrats invested in our communities. Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans gutted SNAP & Medicaid to pay for tax cuts for the ultra-wealthy. You work too hard to keep being put last.
My vote was about you - and everyone looking for a good-paying job that offers dignity and a future.

By bringing your tax dollars home, the BIL created millions of good-paying union jobs, made high-speed internet affordable and available everywhere, kindled a once-in-a-century rebuilding of Texas' infrastructure, investing hundreds of millions of dollars in El Paso.
Five years ago, I was the only member of Congress in our region to vote for the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law. https://t.co/tW7H80GAn1

While it’s important that passenger safety has been prioritized, Members of Congress and the American public deserve full transparency and as much information as quickly as possible from the White House and the appropriate members of the administration. 

It’s been over two and a https://t.co/GQhIqVgeXR
I’m looking forward to ending cruelty that has been the hallmark for this administration and focusing on uplifting our fellow human beings. https://t.co/MWm9QDRYHh

I’m committed to getting my bipartisan, comprehensive immigration reform bill - the Dignity Act - to the President’s desk.

I’m ready to work, listen, and make this legislation better. I encourage all of my colleagues to come to the table and work with me. Our communities deserve nothing less.

The House has taken an important step toward delivering long-overdue justice for our nation’s combat-injured veterans.

The Major Richard Star Act would end the unfair practice of forcing medically retired veterans to choose between the military retirement pay they earned and the VA disability compensation they deserve.

I’m proud to support this bipartisan effort as it passed the House today, and will continue to fight to get the Major Richard Star Act over the finish line.
@GajereCN @QuinDeer I looked around https://t.co/gSonZq4h3x

This Veterans Day, we honor all who wore the uniform by reaffirming a simple promise: our obligation to those who served doesn’t end when their service does. 

Veterans deserve the care, benefits, and support they’ve earned. Today, and always, I’m thinking of our veterans. https://t.co/I67cyivYkQ
@dustypeeps @QuinDeer 10000%. Democrats and Republicans have different 'sides' of the floor, but otherwise we usually sit by friends or people we need to talk to
@QuinDeer Sit wherever!

I'm incredibly supportive of finding a more prominent location for our plaque honoring law enforcement that responded on January 6th.

It's a shame Republicans hid it for so long. We're righting that wrong. https://t.co/CG8q9a8kT2
I’m proud of Annunciation House for fighting for their values and I’m grateful this nightmare has reached a conclusion.
Under Democratic leadership, our state will be redirecting its time, energy, and resources to issues that matter instead of the partisan bullying we’d grown accustomed to under Republicans.

This long overdue good news is a direct result of record Democratic turnout in our community and across the state.

This is what happens when the people use our collective voice at the ballot box. https://t.co/SCHdp9eLAY

Permitting reform must be undertaken expeditiously, but it can’t happen at the expense of tribal communities.

Proud to stand with my colleagues in urging the Senate to vote no on BAAJA. https://t.co/DO3W4n8piR

An immediate priority for our party should be to prevent private companies like Acquisition Logistics, CoreCivic, and others from further profiting off human suffering and cruelty.

Accountability at places like Camp East Montana and Dilley is coming. https://t.co/ZQQcxwlFM4

I am deeply saddened to hear of the passing of Dolores Huerta.

For 70 years, she paved the way for working people and the labor movement in our country. She will be deeply missed.

May she rest in power. https://t.co/smChplB7Qf

My heart hurts thinking of the terror these precious, innocent children and the school staff and teachers lived through -- but even moreso for the grieving family members whose babies  and loved ones were taken from them.

Praying that the Bend community find peace and comfort in this tragic time.

We cannot allow ourselves to become numb to the pain and horror that a country with unfettered access to guns creates.

Attacking your political rivals (22 days before an election, no less) is un-American at its core.

This is fascism and it could not be more plain. https://t.co/hgvZ5lxoG4

Over the past three years since the Hamas terrorist attack on October 7th, an unimaginable number of Israeli and Palestinian lives have been lost or irrevocably changed amidst horrific death and destruction.  As we reflect on this day, I join the chorus of continued calls for a permanent, enduring peace that prioritizes the dignity of all people.

So proud that El Paso has a county attorney (and her great team) fighting for fair elections free from coercive influence - a battle fought and a victory won on behalf of all voters everywhere. https://t.co/Njsiy24fNe

Reminder: back in June, we tried to pass an amendment to prevent the use of federal funds for border barriers at Big Bend, and every single Republican - including those from Texas - voted against it. https://t.co/Srps2e7MYs https://t.co/RzoBwRpFss

An almost $2 trillion corporation using tax loopholes to get richer off of American taxpayers.

I'm working on a bill to close this now.

The terror and lawlessness must stop. ICE continues to violently target legal residents - and American citizens - without transparency or accountability. Still, after shooting Wilber Rafael Garces Perez yesterday, ICE announced plans to deport him.   ICE cannot shoot someone and then disappear them to sidestep accountability. Texans deserve answers and a full, independent investigation into the shooting of Wilber Rafael Garces Perez. Read more:

On this POW/MIA Recognition Day, we pause to remember the brave servicemembers who were taken as prisoners of war and those who remain missing in action. 

My thoughts are with the families still waiting for answers. They are not - and never will be - forgotten. https://t.co/ASNubVMzT8

What we choose to fund is a statement of our values.

The Trump administration is prioritizing its war in Iran instead of prioritizing you.

That's enough to forgive student loan debt for nearly a million borrowers.

We could've built over 73,000 affordable housing units across the country.

There's so many other things we could've funded to improve your life, but the Trump administration started this reckless war.

Trump's war in Iran has cost Americans $38 billion.

With that money, we could've funded more than 3 years of Head Start.

We could've paid for almost 5 million people to get a two year degree at a community college.

Republicans kicked millions off their healthcare and food assistance programs with their One Big Beautiful Bill.

But another less talked about provision? Massive corporate tax breaks that AI and data center companies are eagerly taking advantage of.

Our nation has begged its government to do the right thing and release every document in the Epstein Files. The President's DOJ has withheld more than 3 million pages.
 
I joined the discharge petition for the Epstein Files Transparency Act II to force a vote on allowing state attorneys general, victims of Epstein, and Members of Congress to challenge the DOJ on its failure to comply with the full release of the files. Survivors deserve nothing less.

@waynehhsiung Protecting animals is a passion of mine I've been pursuing throughout my time in Congress. I first introduced this particular bill back in 2023.

I'll always welcome whatever support I can get, both from my Democratic colleagues and across the aisle.

The Pigs in Gestation Stalls (PIGS) Act would permanently ban the use of gestation stalls, used to house pregnant pigs, and would require the pigs to have no less than 24 square feet of space. 

Meaning pregnant pigs to lie down, stand up, and move about freely; they deserve no less.

Pigs are sentient beings that feel pain and suffering. They are sensitive, gentle, and smart creatures that are treated with incredible cruelty before they are sent to be slaughtered.

I have a bill to ban these use of these crates. Tell your member of Congress to sign on. https://t.co/puWPb96gNv

I will continue to work diligently through the Appropriations Committee to advance long-term funding bills that prioritize our community and avoid the culture war provisions my Republican colleagues continue to obsess about.

Today, I voted in favor of the Senate legislation to fund our government, protect vulnerable populations, continue funding vital programs, and avoid yet another Republican shutdown.

This is a bipartisan CR that funds our government through mid-December; this is what happens when the Republican majority works with Democrats — agreement is indeed possible.
